seed.title: ElderMind cognitive resilience companion

signals.claim: Families want lightweight daily cognitive exercises and decline signals, but do not want a medical device workflow.
Voice-first interaction can reduce setup friction for older adults if privacy and escalation are explicit.

constraints: Human confirmation is required before caregiver escalation.
Unit economics must include support and privacy review cost.

solution_path.name: Plan from repository resources
solution_path.output: Overall staged solution path with every best-fit repo tool bound before execution.

solution_path.name: Opportunity sensing
solution_path.output: Signal list; Desk research memo; One-page opportunity brief

solution_path.name: Initial screening
solution_path.output: TAM/SAM/SOM estimate; Competitor map; Capability gap; Rough unit economics

solution_path.name: Deep analysis
solution_path.output: Market deep dive; Risk register; Financial model

solution_path.name: Validation
solution_path.output: Hypothesis list; MVP design; Validation report

solution_path.output: Business model; Resource plan; GTM plan; Risk mitigation plan

solution_path.output: Phase-1 execution checklist; First revenue record

stages.name: Opportunity sensing

tool_plan.role: Scan trends and community signals before any scoring work.
tool_plan.why_best_fit: It is the imported detector tool dedicated to trend and signal capture.

tool_plan.role: Extract repeated user pains from community and interview inputs.
tool_plan.why_best_fit: It turns raw signals into pain evidence before screening starts.

done_when: At least two independent signals are recorded

tool_plan.role: Estimate TAM/SAM/SOM during the first market screen.
tool_plan.why_best_fit: It is the purpose-built sizing tool referenced by the market screening template.

tool_plan.role: Build the quick competitor map for initial positioning.
tool_plan.why_best_fit: It is the best available repo tool for competitor landscape structure.

tool_plan.role: Run rough unit economics before the first Go/Maybe/Kill decision.
tool_plan.why_best_fit: It is the imported model for CAC, LTV, margin, and payback assumptions.

tool_plan.role: Convert the screen into a scored Go/Maybe/Kill recommendation.
tool_plan.why_best_fit: It is the explicit scorecard tool for the screening gate.

stages.name: Deep analysis

tool_plan.role: Refine segment sizing for the deep market analysis.
tool_plan.why_best_fit: Deep analysis should reuse the sizing tool instead of inventing a new estimate path.

tool_plan.role: Run the deeper competitor teardown and differentiation map.
tool_plan.why_best_fit: The same matrix tool is the best fit for both quick and deep competitive work.

tool_plan.role: Build full NPV, sensitivity, and scenario analysis.
tool_plan.why_best_fit: It is the best available financial tool for the ANALYZE gate.

done_when: NPV and sensitivity assumptions are inspectable
P0 regulatory risks are called out

stages.name: Validation

tool_plan.role: Select validation experiments and pass/fail checks for critical assumptions.
tool_plan.why_best_fit: It is the imported detector tool focused on validation design.

done_when: Paid or return-user evidence is linked
Privacy and safety checks are complete

stages.name: Business planning

tool_plan.role: Translate validation results into budget and resource planning assumptions.
tool_plan.why_best_fit: Business planning should carry forward the same inspected economics model.

tool_plan.role: Assemble the business model, GTM, resource plan, and risk plan artifacts.
tool_plan.why_best_fit: It is the repo tool for turning analysis outputs into shareable planning artifacts.

done_when: Launch decision has owner, budget, and rollback condition

stages.name: Execution

tool_plan.role: Generate the launch checklist and first revenue record artifact.
tool_plan.why_best_fit: The launch phase needs a durable execution artifact, not a new analysis tool.

done_when: First measurable revenue or qualified customer commitment is recorded

stages.name: Monitoring

tool_plan.role: Continue monitoring market and community signal changes.
tool_plan.why_best_fit: Monitoring should reuse the scanner rather than silently dropping signal capture.

tool_plan.role: Track recurring user pain after launch.
tool_plan.why_best_fit: It is the best repo fit for turning qualitative monitoring into repeatable evidence.

tool_plan.role: Produce iteration reviews from monitoring data.
tool_plan.why_best_fit: It keeps the monitor loop inspectable through generated artifacts.

done_when: Metrics are reviewed and next action is decided

tool_coverage.policy: Every imported detector tool must be assigned to at least one stage before execution.

minimum_evidence: kill reason is recorded when below threshold
at least one direct user signal

acceptance: The imported detector assets are discoverable without depending on the deleted source repository.
A seed opportunity can be converted into a seven-stage ODE plan deterministically.
The plan states deliverables, gate decisions, verification commands, and generated artifacts.

artifacts.purpose: Golden input for the minimal opportunity task executor.
Deterministic closed-loop plan generated from the imported detector assets.
